FAQ

Is the reading real?

It is for entertainment. An AI writes it from the lines it can see in your photo. It does not predict your future or give advice.

What happens to my photo?

The app resizes it and removes camera details, then sends it once over an encrypted connection to make your reading. Our server and the AI provider do not keep it. The photo and your reading are saved in your history on this phone only; Settings, Delete my data erases them.

The app says no palm was found.

Open your hand flat with the fingers apart in good light, and keep the whole palm in view.

I used all my free readings.

Pro lifts the limit. You can see the plans in the app; the price and any free trial for new subscribers are shown in Google Play.

How do I restore Pro on a new phone?

Open the Pro screen and tap Restore purchases, using the same Google account you bought with.

How do I report a reading?

On the result screen tap Report this reading; your email app opens.
